description:
I have an urgent need for a Front End Developer on W2 in Pennington NJ. 
 
 Can use non locals, phone to skype interview or F2F 
 
 Main technologies HTML, CSS, JavaScript and UI 
 
 Frontend Web Developer: 
 I think this position boils down to these 7 strengths. 
 · HTML 
 · CSS 
 · JavaScript 
 · Responsive Web Design 
 · Angular 1.x 
 · .NET 
 · ADA / web accessibility 
 The person doesn’t have to be an expert in every area but a healthy combination of 5 or 6 of these is preferred. 
 
 Requirements: 
 · Minimum of 5 years of experience in modern web development using HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/jQuery based on web standards 
 · Understanding of how to scale CSS for multiple large websites, with different branding. 
 · Expert in Responsive Web Design 
 · Experience with JavaScript frameworks, especially Angular 1.x 
 · Solid experience with CSS preprocessors (SASS/LESS) 
 · Experience using SVG 
 · Understands website performance 
 · Works well within a team or leading a team 
 · Communicates effectively with business, UX, management, and co-workers 
 · Experience with the .NET framework, C#, Visual Studio, Team Foundation Version Control (TFVC, TFS) 
 
 Nice-to-haves 
 · Experience with Web Accessibility / ADA 
 · Familiarity with Adobe Tools (Photoshop/Illustrator) 
 · Experience with Angular and/or React 
 · Experience with Grunt, Gulp, or other build tools 
 · Experience working in the wealth management or banking industries 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
